S0122.reason: The friend lacked genuine agreement to the burglary and larceny because he intended to thwart the crime, so no conspiracy; he also did not commit burglary or larceny.

S0124.reason: A prima facie duty is presumptive and can be overridden by specific exceptions, not absolute or contingent on consent.

S0128.reason: The lease renewed as a periodic tenancy, and the landlord cannot terminate without cause on the facts given.
